test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2024: Official Paper (Held On: 10 Jul, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option to substitute the underlined part of the given sentence.

Mr. Sengupta’s complaint to the higher authority was only a __red herring__.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2****)**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The phrase "red herring" means something that is misleading or distracting from the main issue.
 
• Option 2, "clever bluff," is the most appropriate substitute as it conveys a similar meaning of deceit or distraction.
 
• The other options do not adequately capture the essence of a "red herring."

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"Mr. Sengupta's complaint to the higher authority was only a clever bluff."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: "fortunate evidence"** - This does not fit the context of the sentence.
 
• **Option 3: "discouraging act"** - This phrase does not convey the idea of misleading or distraction.
 
• **Option 4: "candid confession"** - This is the opposite of a "red herring" as it implies honesty.
